_rubric.e: earnings impact on the tagged sub-industry's forward earnings/cash-flow power, -5 (existential) to +5 (transformational), half steps allowed
_rubric.b: breadth: share of the sub-industry's market cap affected: 1 <25%, 2 25-60%, 3 >60%
_rubric.c: certainty at the time: 1 proposed/rumoured, 2 likely, 3 enacted/occurred
_rubric.ep: true when the event is an episode (a year-long flow description) rather than a dated catalyst; episodes get half weight in the calibration fit
_rubric.per: optional per-bucket overrides of e/p/b/c when the same event cuts different ways for different sub-industries
_rubric.anchors: permanent ban on the whole sub-industry -100; iPhone launch for Apple +100; Nvidia May-2023 guide for semis +90; GLP-1 breakthrough for pharma +80; COVID for lodging/cruise -60 (severe, temporary); Medicare Advantage rate notice +/-25 to 50; 25bp Fed cut for SMID biotech +10 to +20
